theme_and_archetype.archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast - tailored for Authority and Clarity)
theme_and_archetype.description: A clean, functional, and authoritative internal SaaS dashboard for NENO SPACE. It focuses on scannability, operational efficiency, and a structured layout that prioritizes data readability without feeling cluttered.

rules: Headings should use tight letter spacing.
Use bold/black weight for emphasis in stat cards.
Use #F5F5F5 for the main application background to make white cards pop.
Primary CTA buttons must use #0066CC with white text.
Success indicators, online statuses, and validations use #00AA55.
Warnings, important highlights, and action-required items use #FFAA00.
Text must meet APCA contrast ratios against backgrounds.

surface_styles.cards: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
surface_styles.header: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and links should darken slightly or increase shadow on hover.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for standard interactions.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders instead of generic spinners where possible.

rules: Use consistent stroke width (usually 2px) and sizes.
Use icons to accompany labels in sidebar and key actions, do not rely on icons alone.

login_split_bg.description: Abstract 3D geometric shapes background for the left side of the login screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: The frontend uses standard .js/.jsx files (not .tsx). Ensure all generated components and Shadcn components use JavaScript.

Update tailwind.config.js and index.css to map the custom color palette to CSS variables. Specifically set: primary to #0066CC, secondary to #00AA55, accent to #FFAA00, background to #F5F5F5, foreground (text primary) to #333333, and muted foreground (text secondary) to #666666.
Implement Shadcn UI components for Tables, Forms, Inputs, Buttons, Dialogs, Dropdown Menus, and Cards.

For the Login page: Implement a 2-column split-screen layout on large screens. Use the provided 'login_split_bg' image on the left side with the 'NENO SPACE' brand overlay, and place the login form on the right. Add a forgot password link (UI only).

Dashboard App Shell: Create a layout component with a fixed Sidebar and a sticky Header. The main content area MUST have bg-[#F5F5F5] so white cards stand out. Use the font family rules specified (Outfit for headings, Manrope for body).
Dashboard Page: Display stat cards using grid (Control Room grid). Cards should be clean, flat, and use the specified border styles.
Member Page: Build a complex table with searching and filtering logic. Map mock data effectively and use the avatar images from media_urls for mock user profiles.
Member Detail Page: Create a profile view featuring file upload UI (Shadcn customized input) and editable fields. Use the secondary color (#00AA55) for save/success states.
Mock Data: Ensure robust mock JSON data generation for Members, Stations, and Zones to make the UI look fully populated.
IMPORTANT: Use `data-testid` attributes on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, table rows) for testing.
